finding: The synthetic investigation demonstrates that identity, endpoint, OT, network, physical and cargo signals can be correlated into a single incident picture.
INC-T21-001 combines anomalous vendor access with OT and business-process indicators in a short time window.
Controlled vendor remote access, strong MFA, cross-source monitoring and OT-aware correlation are relevant controls for the simulated environment.
Prioritise investigation and containment where remote-access anomalies coincide with OT state/command changes or cargo integrity events.
